lines.en: Shuffles slowly, with a hoarse voice.

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉，牙齿咯吱作响。
lines.en: Chomping on decayed flesh, creaking teeth.
Scouring the area, searching for food.
Chewing decayed flesh, making grating sounds.

lines.zh: 脚踝歪了，还是一步一步挪。
lines.en: My ankle is bent, yet I shuffle step by step.

lines.zh: 废墟的灰落满肩膀，我不拍。
lines.en: Ruin ash covers my shoulders; I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤下露出骨头。

lines.en: Weak green glow in its eyes.
Decaying flesh sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里卡着一口气。
lines.en: A breath is stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 我这一身破布条，跟你走吧。
lines.en: These ragged strips of me will come with you.
Advances toward the player, trying to attack.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的嘶嘶声，吸引注意。

lines.en: Looks for the player, making gurgling sounds.
Locks onto the player, shuffling forward.
Observes the player, making hoarse sounds.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里卡着半句话。
lines.en: Half a word is stuck in my throat.
I shuffle on, my neck bent sideways.

lines.zh: 我的下颌一直在轻轻打颤。

lines.en: Don't eat me, you'll become like this!

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我顺着追。
lines.en: I follow the warmth coming off you.
You don't want to try my meat?

lines.zh: 别靠近，我咬过的人都没救。
lines.en: Stay back; no one I bit was ever cured.
Move, I'm going to eat you!
Don't move, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 给我让开，这里是我的领地！
lines.en: Move for me, this is my territory!
I won't let you get close!
Get out, I don't need a partner!
Your spot is better, give it to me!
We don't need you, get out!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的去路，去死吧！
跟我一起，我们可以更强大！
lines.en: Mate with me, we can be stronger!
Before the turning, I loved someone too.
Don't be afraid. I won't bite deep.

lines.zh: 只有我们才能相互理解！
lines.en: Only we can understand each other!

lines.zh: 跟我一起，你会有更多力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll have more power!

lines.zh: 跟我走，至少不会被咬第二次。
lines.en: Come with me, you won't get bitten twice.
We need each other, don't we?

lines.zh: 加入我，你将不再是孤身一人！
lines.en: Join me, you won't be alone!
Together with me, you'll be safer!

lines.zh: 啃食腐肉，发出沉闷声响
lines.en: Chewing on rotting flesh, making dull sounds
Scream in agony after being bitten

lines.zh: 目标进入视线，开始行动
你的脚印里有没干的血。
lines.en: There's wet blood in your footprints.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，开始紧追不舍
风把活人的味道送过来了。
lines.en: The wind brings me the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 废墟里还有会动的东西。
lines.en: Something in the ruins still moves.
I do not run; sooner or later you stop.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，在空楼里很响。
lines.en: Your steps echo loudly in the empty building.
The heat beneath your skin is jumping.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准备咬下一口
锁定目标，准备撕开伤口
lines.en: Target acquired, preparing to tear open

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把距离磨短。
lines.en: Step by step, I grind the distance down.
My arms are rising; do not complain it is slow.
Retreat to the broken wall, and you are blocked.
A bite never heals, you know that.
My joints creak, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你的伤口在流血，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your wound is bleeding; I can smell it.
Turning takes one bite; it is quick.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腿，先咬那里。
lines.en: I watch your legs; I bite there first.

lines.zh: 这扇木门，我拍两下就开。
lines.en: Two slaps and this wooden door gives.
There is still cloth stuck in my teeth.
Sss, only hunger in my world.
One bite, and the bleeding will not stop!

lines.zh: 抓破你的小腿，跑不动了吧！
lines.en: I claw your calf; you cannot run now!
My teeth sink into your shoulder and will not come out!

lines.zh: 推你一把，摔在碎玻璃上！
lines.en: I shove you down onto broken glass!

lines.zh: 指甲抓过你的脸，留下口子！
lines.en: My nails rake your face and leave a gash!

lines.zh: 咬住不放，痛感会留很久！
lines.en: I hold my bite; the pain will linger!

lines.zh: 废墟的瓦砾被推开，我站起来。
lines.en: Rubble shifts, and I stand up.

lines.zh: 街角的路灯下，我抬起了头。
lines.en: Under the streetlamp, I raise my head.

lines.zh: 末世的风一吹，我就醒了。
lines.en: One gust of the wasteland wind wakes me.

lines.zh: 这片群系，处处都能生成我。
lines.en: In this biome, I can spawn anywhere.

lines.zh: 炸飞了半条腿，我还在爬！
lines.en: Half a leg blown off, and I still crawl!

lines.zh: 饿得肠子打结，更想吃人。
lines.en: Hunger knots my gut and makes me crave human flesh.
